meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描项目，找出未被引用的变量、导入、函数、类型和文件，核实确认后分批并行删除，每批单独提交，最后运行类型检查、测试和构建，确保项目不会坏。
howto.when: 当你说“remove dead code”“dead code”等关键词，或要求清理无用代码时触发；也可指定只处理某个文件、目录或符号。

say.text: 把项目里没用的代码都删掉。
say.note: 触发全项目扫描并清理。

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录里的死代码。
删掉未使用的函数和导入，别动入口文件。
say.note: 遵守保护规则，保留入口点。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project for unreferenced variables, imports, functions, types, and files, verifies them, then removes them in parallel batches with individual commits, finally running typecheck, tests, and build to keep the project intact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "remove dead code", "dead code", etc., or ask to clean up unused code. You can also scope it to a specific file, directory, or symbol.

say_en.text: Remove all unused code from the project.
Only clean dead code in src/utils.
say_en.note: Scope is limited to that directory.

say_en.text: Remove unused functions and imports, keep entry files.
say_en.note: Respects protection rules for entry points.
